When selecting a [[Missions|Mission]] in [[Helldivers 2|''Helldivers 2'']] using the Galactic War console, a difficulty can be selected between level 1 {{Difficulty|1}} and level 10 {{Difficulty|10}}.

Each difficulty level offers a different set of missions. For example, some missions offered to the player on {{Difficulty|1}} are not offered on {{Difficulty|6}}. 

== Effects==
*The number of {{Currency|Medals}}, {{Currency|Requisition}}, and {{Currency|Experience}} you earn from a mission all depends on the difficulty you select. 
**Higher difficulty missions have increasing percentage multipliers for Requisition Slips and Experience, from +25% on {{Difficulty|3}} to +300% on {{Difficulty|10}}
**The Eradication Main Objective base-reward depends on the selected difficulty. Each difficulty affects the rewards by {{Currency|Experience|20|notext}} and {{Currency|Requisition|100|notext}}. E.g. {{Difficulty|6}} Eradication-mission rewards {{Currency|Experience|120|notext}} and {{Currency|Requisition|600|notext}}, and {{Difficulty|3}} rewards  {{Currency|Experience|60|notext}} and  {{Currency|Requisition|300|notext}}.
* Enemy forces are enhanced to increasingly lethal degrees.
**The number of enemies and the type of enemy both depend on the difficulty level set.
**The frequency of enemy patrol being [[Spawn Mechanics|spawned]] increases alongside the difficulty.
***In relation, the frequency of [[Democracy Space Station#Tactical Actions|DSS Eagle Strike]] and other tactical actions during missions decreases with increased difficulty.
*The number of [[Operation Modifiers]] present during the mission.
**One modifier is added on {{Difficulty|5}}.
**A second modifier is added on {{Difficulty|8}}.

* The number of Sub-Objectives required to complete a [[Main Objectives|Main Objective]] increases at higher difficulties.
* The number and size of enemy Outposts ([[Terminid Nest|Bug Nests]]/[[Automaton Outpost|Automaton Outposts]]/[[Illuminate Encampment|Illuminate Encampments]])
** Outpost spawning can vary quite drastically depending on a number of other factors as well, including biome, mission type, and [[Factions|faction]].

*The number of [[Optional Objectives]] increases at higher difficulties.
*Map size increases to accommodate the increased amount of Mission Objectives on the Expedition-mission. The size increase is lesser on the [[Super Earth Metropolis|Metropolis]] [[Biomes|biome]] maps.

pages.Personal Orders:
{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Missions}}

'''Personal Orders''' (abbreviated as '''PO''') are optional orders specific to each player that rotate every 24-hours, and give {{Currency|Medals|15}} when completed. They expire once the time is up, but can be completed if the mission is initiated before the reset.

== Gameplay ==
In order to complete a Personal Order, Helldivers must dive down to a planet (once or multiple times) and complete the specific task. Depending on the Personal Order, the requirements may require different loadouts so Helldivers should balance their equipment accordingly.

While Personal Orders are individually completed, any Helldiver in the squad can contribute to other's PO goal (i.e. a Stalwart user contributes to all squad members, including the Helldiver equipped with AT). Despite this, Helldivers should plan accordingly since squad contribution may not be as efficient, and may need to proactively contribute to complete the PO in a timely manner.

* Kill NUMBER [[Illuminate]]
* Kill NUMBER [[Enemies|Unique Enemies]]

* Kill NUMBER [[Enemies|Unique Enemies]] with [[Weapons|WEAPON]]

==== NOTES ====
*Only fatal hits (to main health-points / HP) are counted as kills (E.G. [[Bug Hole]]s and thrusters of [[Dropship]]s won't count), but [[Automaton Fabricator|Fabricators]] and [[Spore Spewer|Spore Spewers]] count as enemy kills.
**The fatal hit kill on structures is only counted with the proper depletion of health-point; [[demolition]] will not count as a kill (E.G. destruction of a Fabricator via vents).
*During [[Extraction]], any kills made by Pelican 1 is credited to the Helldiver who finished the input-code. Automatic and Emergency calldown Pelican 1 kills are only credited towards overall collective kill-count of SEAF.

'''Detector Tower''' is an [[Missions#Tactical Objectives|Optional Objective]] exclusive to the {{Automaton|text}}, consisting of a large, rotating surveillance tower that will summon reinforcements if it detects the presence of Helldivers. To complete the objective, Helldivers must destroy the tower.

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Automaton Detector Tower
** The [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]] will be available to call down when near the tower.
* Rewards: {{Currency|Requisition|200}}, {{Currency|Experience|50}}

== Tactical Information<!-- Old version mentioned "active Hellpod-stratagems" as being valid Detector Tower targets as well, confused if this means sentries/emplacements -->==

* The Detector Tower has a 150-meter range in which it can detect Helldivers, within its distinctive red vision cone.
** The position of the vision cone means that Helldivers that are very close to the Detector Tower cannot be spotted.
** Going prone will render Helldivers completely invisible to the Detector Tower.
* If a Helldiver is spotted, the tower will sound an audible alarm and begin summoning constant waves of bot drops until it can no longer see any Helldivers.
** [[Dropship|Dropships]] spawned in this manner will deploy their units on the last known position of the Helldiver.
* The [[Demolition]] requirement of 50 means that a Hellbomb is unnecessary if alternate options are available.
** Common examples include the [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]], [[Orbital Precision Strike]] and [[SEAF Artillery]] shells.
** Clever positioning can trick [[Cannon Turret|Cannon Turrets]] into destroying the Detector Tower with their shots.
* The Hellbomb's large AOE means that it can be called down far away from the Detector Tower (where one is at little risk of being spotted) and still complete the objective.
* Detector Towers will occasionally spawn inside of [[Automaton Outpost|Fortresses]]. They function identically to standard Detector Towers, but the Hellbomb will '''not''' be available to call down to destroy them. They are also not mandatory to destroy to mark the Fortress as "cleared".

== Trivia ==

* Due to the Tower's distinctive appearance, it is often colloquially referred to as the [[wikipedia:en:Lord of the Rings|'Eye of Sauron']] by many Helldivers.
* Detector Towers can be used to farm Automaton kills for [[Major Orders]], as their alarm state bypasses the global cooldown of bot flares, allowing a constant stream of incoming [[Dropship|Dropships]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an Automaton [[Optional Objectives|Optional Objective]] where [[The Helldivers|Helldivers]] are tasked with hacking and compromising it with a virus to disrupt their defenses. Upon completion, all Automaton Turrets map-wide will be scrambled, making them unable to target Helldivers.

== Objective Steps ==
* Locate and unlock system access port
** Helldivers must find and interact with a SSSD container found inside the outpost
* Use Stratagem: [[SSSD Delivery]]
** Helldivers must call down the SSSD by inputting:
{{Stratagem_code|down|down|down|down|down|up|up}} 
* Collect the SSSD HARD DRIVE
* Insert SSSD into receptacle
* Hack into the terminal to sabotage stationary defenses
** Helldivers must find and interact with the terminal found inside the outpost
* Bypass terminal security
** Helldivers are presented with a puzzle, requiring them to match Automaton letters into the correct order, shown by the key on the right side of the terminal. 
[[File:Compromise Automaton Defenses OO Terminal.png|400px|class=responsive-image]]
* Use terminal to trace defense network
** Helldivers must interact with the terminal to trace the designated coordinates in the grid using directional inputs. After the cursor moves over the target coordinate, Helldivers must not move the cursor away from the target coordinate until it has finished calculating.
* Use terminal to upload virus
** Helldivers must enter an 11 digit code to finalize the upload and complete the objective.

== Tactical Information ==
* The outpost is typically heavily guarded by several [[Cannon Turret]]s on each side.
** Outposts on [[Automaton Megafactory|Megafactories]] and [[Colonies|Colonies]] also contain [[Anti-Air Emplacement]]s that will disable the use of any [[Eagle|Eagle Stratagems]] for Helldivers within 150m.
* When the objective is completed, all Cannon Turrets, [[Bunker Turret]]s, [[Mortar Emplacement]]s, and [[Anti-Air Emplacement]]s on the map will start to malfunction, visibly sparking and firing in random directions, unable to target Helldivers or deny Eagle deployments.
** Optional Objectives such as Mortar Emplacements will not be considered completed when compromised. Helldivers must still destroy them to gain completion rewards.

The '''Pump Fuel To ICBM''' is a Main Objective in ''Helldivers 2'' that can appear on both [[Terminids|Terminid]] and [[Automatons|Automaton]] controlled planets.

== Objective Steps ==
* Activate terminal
** Upon reaching the fueling station, Helldivers will encounter a small amount of enemies guarding the fueling station.
** After clearing the area, Helldivers must activate the terminal by interacting with it. Then, Helldivers must adjust the fueling route to move fuel from the Local Storage to the Missile Silo; the up and down directional inputs will swap the current pipe in the highlighted column.
* Log in to terminal
** The Helldivers must input the directional code as seen on the terminal.
* Redirect fuel to new target
** On the terminal screen, the Helldivers must create a pipeline from the fuel output (left) to the new target (top right).
** To do so, they must press "[[File:Stratagem Arrow Up.svg|20px]]" or "[[File:Stratagem Arrow Down.svg|20px]]" to move the pipes up and down. And press "[[File:Stratagem Arrow Left.svg|20px]]" and "[[File:Stratagem Arrow Right.svg|20px]]" to move from side to side.
[[File:Pump Fuel To ICBM MO S3.png|alt=Terminal screen of the pipe puzzle, where Helldivers must adjust the route of the pipes to the Missile Silo.|400px]]
* Turn all valves indicated by the terminal
** 3 valves will be located in the general vicinity. The Helldivers must now adjust the three valves located around the fueling station to the right by holding "[[File:Stratagem Arrow Right.svg|20px]]" until they glow; the terminal will also make a loud beep sound to confirm a valve has been adjusted correctly.
** After successfully adjusting all the valves, Helldivers will need to return to the terminal and press "[[File:Stratagem Arrow Up.svg|20px]]" to activate the pumps. Upon activation, the mission is successfully completed.
[[File:Pump Fuel To ICBM MO S4 Valves.png|alt=All three valves requiring adjustment within player view.|400px]]

== Tactical Information ==
* Enemies will continuously spawn and patrol near the fueling station if the mission has yet to be completed. It is recommended that Helldivers conceal themselves as they complete the objective, or to quickly dispatch nearby patrols if necessary.

Commando Missions are {{Automatons}} [[Automaton]] Exclusive [[Missions]] appearing only in special Commando Operations on any Automaton planet undergoing a [[Liberation]] Campaign.

Commando missions provide Helldivers with little to no support from the [[Super Destroyer]], rendering Helldivers unable to call in stratagems for a majority of the mission. Commando missions are highly suited to [[Stealth]] gameplay as they discourage most direct confrontation with the enemy, instead prioritizing a playstyle that focuses on avoiding the enemy and silently completing objectives.

== Unique Mechanics ==
=== Threat Level ===
Unique to Commando Missions is the system of a varying '''threat level'''. When the mission starts, enemy presence will be low, resulting in a lower than average amounts of enemies in outposts, POIs, and patrols as well as a lower amount of larger enemies (depending on difficulty). When an enemy calls reinforcements, not only does a bot drop arrive, but the threat level increases as well. This results in more enemies present throughout the map at outposts, POIs, and patrols. Along with this, higher level enemies will start to appear more commonly (i.e. regular patrols may contain more [[Hulk]]s or [[Reinforced Scout Strider]]s).

=== Stratagems ===
Helldivers are only able to call in Stratagems when the Super Destroyer is in the area. When first landing in the mission area for the first time, '''Helldivers are given 60 seconds to call in stratagems'''. This time is best used to call in the requisitioned Support Weapon/Backpack that Helldivers brought with them. When this time is up, the Super Destroyer will leave the area and will not return unless Helldivers call it back, in which it will return for another 60 seconds. '''The Super Destroyer can only return once per mission, per Helldiver''', so it is advised to only call it to return when faced against overwhelming odds.
